subject.title: skill_workshop apply times out ("Approval timed out") on large proposals (~28KB)

question: Should the Skill Workshop lifecycle fix use the open maintainer PR's bounded 70s approval plus actionable pending-state result, or preserve/extend the older 120s/300s approval-window design?
rationale: The remaining choice changes the operator approval contract for generated skill lifecycle actions, so automation should not choose the timeout policy while a maintainer-authored closing PR is open.

options.title: Use The Bounded Approval-Flow PR
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 if its approval budget and actionable timeout result match the desired lifecycle contract.

options.title: Prefer A Longer Approval Window
options.body: Keep this issue open and redirect the fix toward a longer or configurable approval TTL, with explicit watchdog and security-boundary proof.

options.title: Reject Agent-Tool Lifecycle Changes
options.body: Close the linked PRs and document CLI/UI apply as the supported path for slow approval decisions.

recommendation.title: Use The Bounded Approval-Flow PR
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100498 if its approval budget and actionable timeout result match the desired lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the current assignee and author of the open closing PR that selects the proposed policy.
